about: Shipped calls the approval.md CLASS-DIFF job (scripts/approval-class-diff.sh, the class-diff job in .github/workflows/test.yml) lets deny at the pinned core. Read by approval.md's scripts/overlay-recipes-check.mjs, same schema as its own allowlist: file, command (exact, or "*" for a whole operator README), scope (neutral/box/any), optional columns and flip, a reason that says why, and Carter's acceptance by name (accepted_by human:<id>, accepted_at YYYY-MM-DD). An entry without acceptance fails the job (awaiting acceptance); an entry nothing matches fails as stale. Mirrors approval.md's scripts/overlay-recipes/allowlist.json at the pin.

entries.reason: OPEN, owner or Carter decides (EDGEOS-BLOCK sweep, agentvillage #427 report). The operator selfie recipe names the Hermes home with --root and has classed policy.core since 0.4.6 (APRV-511, protected-path). Dropping --root would class exec.local but dodges a protected-path rule for a script that reads $HERMES_HOME/.env, so neither the overlay nor core was changed. Listed so the check gates every other recipe; remove it once the recipe or the rule is decided.
